rankingPolicy: Final Scope Decision: P2-only Quality Hardening. Approved P1=0, Approved Product P2=2, Approved QA P2=1. Candidate status is not implementation authorization.

candidates.problem: No production P0 was found in the local audit or release identity checks.

candidates.title: Learning-surface reading contract
candidates.problem: Study moves between recall, core meaning and detail; its heading/kicker/audio scale is coherent but not yet documented as a cross-surface reading contract.
candidates.userImpact: Could reduce cognitive friction if real users report that supporting labels or semantic blocks compete with the word.
candidates.proposedDirection: Do not carry this candidate into v1.5; any future real-user evidence must start a separate proposal.
testPlan: separate future semantic user review only if new evidence exists
candidates.risk: Could become an unnecessary visual rewrite if promoted without user evidence.
candidates.decision: REJECTED_THIS_RELEASE: Study Recall / Meaning / Detail is clear, no real-user evidence shows supporting-label competition, and promoting this would risk unnecessary Study redesign.

candidates.title: Audio label ≈11px and small-label consistency
candidates.problem: Study AudioButton is 11px; Word Detail counterpart is 10px; supporting labels span 10–13px.
candidates.userImpact: Small secondary text can be harder to scan during repeated learning sessions.
candidates.proposedDirection: Audit and, only if confirmed, adjust a bounded type token set; do not change page composition.
candidates.risk: Over-enlargement may weaken the quiet hierarchy or cause wrapping.
candidates.decision: APPROVED_FOR_V1_5: narrow small actionable-label typography only; explicitly not a whole-site Typography System rewrite.

candidates.title: Hidden import input accessible name
candidates.problem: The 1x1 hidden file input in Settings has no independent accessible name even though the visible trigger is labeled.
candidates.userImpact: Screen-reader users may encounter an unnamed file control in the tree.
candidates.proposedDirection: Add an explicit accessible name or remove the hidden input from the tree while preserving the existing import flow.
candidates.risk: Changing hidden-control semantics could affect the trigger if not tested.
candidates.decision: APPROVED_FOR_V1_5: make the accessibility tree expose one clear import semantic entry while preserving import, backup, restore, file-picker trigger and DB behavior.

candidates.title: Real browser zoom validation
candidates.problem: Synthetic CSS zoom:2 produced a horizontal signal in Study, but it is not browser page zoom.
candidates.userImpact: Unknown until real browser zoom and assistive-technology review are run.
candidates.proposedDirection: No Chromium product scope: v1.4.1 true Chromium 200% browser zoom is already PASS. Retain only Safari true browser/page zoom as cross-platform QA backlog; Safari is NOT_AVAILABLE on Windows.
testPlan: Safari true browser/page zoom when macOS/Safari is available
candidates.risk: Treating the synthetic signal as a defect would create unnecessary layout churn.
candidates.decision: CLOSED_FOR_CHROMIUM; CROSS_PLATFORM_QA_BACKLOG_FOR_SAFARI; do not enter v1.5 Product Scope.

candidates.title: Windows artifact hash normalization
candidates.problem: A prior deterministic artifact test invocation observed raw line-ending hash drift before a clean rerun.
candidates.userImpact: Maintainers may receive noisy audit failures on Windows.
candidates.proposedDirection: Decide separately whether CI should normalize bytes or compare canonical content; no product changes.
candidates.risk: Changing fixture bytes could obscure provenance if done without a policy.
candidates.decision: SEPARATE_TOOLING_BACKLOG: do not enter the v1.5 Product PR; use a separate QA/Tooling PR if needed.

candidates.title: Non-empty Weak Words and Dictation audit fixtures
candidates.problem: Required screenshots intentionally capture the baseline first-use empty states; non-empty states are not represented in this planning screenshot set.
candidates.userImpact: Future visual audits could cover more of the real task surface.
candidates.proposedDirection: Add isolated deterministic test-only fixtures and screenshots for future visual regression, without changing runtime data or product behavior.
candidates.risk: Fixture setup can become brittle if it starts depending on implementation details.
candidates.decision: APPROVED_FOR_V1_5_QA: test-only, isolated, deterministic and resettable; never write user DB or alter FSRS/ReviewLog/Context/runtime seed.

recommendedScope.rule: v1.5 固化为 0 P1、2 Product P2、1 QA P2；Safari true zoom 与 Windows hash normalization 仅保留 backlog，不进入本次 Product Scope。
